div.head: VIIa Atr 4
div.ab: ⁊ swa hwar swa þæt feoh up arise, dæle man on Godes est æghwilcne pænig.
⁊ swa hwar swa þæt feoh up arise, dæle man on Godes est æghwilcne pænig.
And swa hwar swa þæt feoh up arise, dæle man on Godes est æghwilcne pænig.
Und wo immer dies Geld einkommt, vertheile man um Gottes willen jeden Pfennig [fromm];
And wherever this money comes in, let every penny be distributed for God's sake;
And wherever such payment has to be made, every penny shall be distributed for love of God.
And wherever that money has to be paid, every penny is to be distributed for God’s sake.
And wherever that levy comes to be assessed, every penny is to be distributed for God’s favor.
